title: I Put the Missing-Kimchi Photo on the Fridge They Moderated

parts.text: I taped the empty jar photo at 12:07 p.m. on the fridge they said they moderated. The shelf said LABELED FOOD STAYS. My kimchi did not. I was twenty-nine, ops, standing in a kitchen that made me look like I owned the brine. Moderator Vale said jars were atmosphere. I photographed the label, the empty ring, and Vale's name on the board. Then I left the photo where the jar had been. Vale laughed until facilities asked for the still. The next jar lasted. Vale label-dates the shelf now. A fridge is only a fridge until someone treats it like a clock.

social.video_title: The moderated fridge ate only my kimchi — Part 1/1
social.description: Labeled jar, empty ring, a moderator's board. Facilities asked for the still. Has a fridge ever picked a favorite brine?
